battle.name: 六合之戰
battle.brief: 顯德三年（956）正月起，後周再征南唐，世宗圍壽州，遣趙匡胤、韓令坤分路打援軍。趙匡胤二月夜取滁州，三月奉命以二千兵守六合，四月迎南唐齊王李景達二萬援軍於城外三十里，擊潰之，唐軍陣亡近五千。卡面秦連弩正代表此役吃重的弩兵火力：壽州城下以弩拒攻城者，六合城頭以弩封渡口；而數十萬丁夫築浮橋、轉糧草，是同一場戰爭的另一副骨架。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 秦連弩是秦軍步卒的弩類裝備，以重複弩機進行連續射擊，屬軍隊遠程火力的一環，並可與弓兵及城防火力協同。

countries: 六合之戰是後周顯德三年（956）後周攻南唐之戰中的一場遭遇戰，交戰雙方是中原的後周與江南的南唐。後周由世宗柴榮親自統軍，戰役初期以殿前都虞候趙匡胤、韓令坤等將分路出擊南唐援軍，並任命李重進為淮南道行營都招討使、李谷判壽州行府事，坐鎮壽州城下；除禁軍與藩鎮兵外，周軍又從宋州、陳州、許州、蔡州、亳州、潁州徵召數十萬丁夫，負責築浮橋、轉運糧草、浚治河道，是一支規模極大的工程與運輸軍。南唐方面由中主李璟坐鎮金陵，淮南前線交給清淮軍節度使劉仁贍守壽州，援軍則分成數路：齊王李景達與監軍使陳覺領一路，北面行營應援使皇甫暉與應援都監姚鳳領一路，都監何延錫領水軍。雙方體系都是唐末藩鎮遺制的鎮兵、州縣兵與禁軍混編，軍令出自主將，補給靠江淮運河與長江水路。六合控瓜步渡口，是江北門戶，故此役的基本格局是後周守城、南唐渡江反攻。
countriesEn: The Battle of Liuhe was an engagement fought in 956 (the third year of Xiande of the Later Zhou, the fourteenth year of Baoda of Southern Tang) within the Later Zhou's campaign against Southern Tang. The two sides were the Later Zhou of the Central Plains and Southern Tang of the Jiangnan. The Later Zhou field army was commanded personally by Emperor Shizong Chai Rong. Early in the campaign he split his troops into separate columns to hunt down Tang relief armies, with the Palace Commandant Zhao Kuangyin and Han Lingkun leading columns of their own, and he appointed Li Zhongjin as Military Commissioner of Huainan and Li Gu to preside over the Shouzhou field office, so that the siege of the city would continue under a settled command. Besides the imperial guards and the troops of the regional commands, the Zhou army drew on several hundred thousand corvée labourers from Songzhou, Chenzhou, Xuzhou, Caizhou, Bozhou and Yingzhou, whose job was to build the floating bridges, shift the grain and dredge the waterways: an engineering and transport force of enormous size. On the Southern Tang side the middle emperor Li Jing ruled from Jinling and entrusted the Huainan front to Liu Renzhan, Military Commissioner of Qinghuai, who held Shouzhou. Its relief armies were divided into several columns: the Prince of Qi Li Jingda together with the Inspector Chen Jue led one, the Northern Front Operations Support Commissioner Huangfu Hui together with the Support Deputy Commissioner Yao Feng led another, and the Commissioner He Yanxi commanded the fleet. Both armies were mixtures of garrison troops, prefectural and county levies and imperial guards left over from the late-Tang military system; orders were given by personal commanders and supply came by the waterways of the river and the Yangtze. Liuhe commanded the crossing at Guabu and was the gateway of the north bank, so the basic shape of this battle was a Zhou garrison holding a walled city against a Tang army coming over the water.
people: 後周世宗柴榮是全役的決策者：正陽之戰取勝後，他親率大軍抵壽州，在淝水之北安營，下令把正陽浮橋遷到下蔡，徵召數十萬丁夫協同攻城，自正月二十二日起晝夜不停地攻壽州；相持數日後，改由李重進、李谷繼續圍城，自己則返回京師，下令工匠造戰船、組建水軍。南唐中主李璟在求和被拒之後轉取反攻，下令齊王李景達與監軍使陳覺率兵二萬渡長江北上，期望打通淮南、收復失地。真正決定六合勝負的是殿前都虞候趙匡胤：他先在渦口設伏，斬南唐都監何延錫，俘戰艦五十餘艘；再以數千兵急趨清流關，二月初在山中擊敗皇甫暉、姚鳳所部萬餘人；夜由當地村民引導，穿山後小路、跨浮西澗入滁州城內巷戰，生擒二將；三月奉命以二千兵守六合，四月出城迎擊李景達二萬大軍。守壽州的劉仁贍是南唐另一根支柱，他屢次擊退周軍攻勢，硬是把淮南戰線拖到次年。
peopleEn: Emperor Shizong Chai Rong of the Later Zhou was the decision-maker of the whole campaign. After winning the battle at Zhengyang he led the great army in person to Shouzhou, camped north of the Fei River, ordered the floating bridge at Zhengyang moved down to Xia Cai, and conscripted several hundred thousand labourers to join the assault; from the twenty-second day of the first month he attacked the city of Shouzhou day and night without stopping. After several days of stalemate he handed the siege to Li Zhongjin and Li Gu, and himself returned to the capital, ordering the craftsmen to build war boats and to create a river force. Li Jing, the middle emperor of Southern Tang, had first sued for peace and been refused; he then turned to the counter-offensive and ordered the Prince of Qi Li Jingda together with the Inspector Chen Jue to take twenty thousand men over the Yangtze northward, hoping to reopen the route into Huainan and recover the lost ground. The man who actually decided the fate of Liuhe was Zhao Kuangyin, Palace Commandant: he first ambushed the Tang at Guokou, killing the Commissioner He Yanxi and capturing more than fifty war vessels; then he led several thousand men rapidly to Qingliu Pass and in the second month beat Huangfu Hui and Yao Feng with some ten thousand men in the hills; at night he was guided by local villagers, took a path behind the mountain, crossed the Feixi Stream and fought a street battle inside Chuzhou, taking both Tang commanders alive. In the third month he was ordered to hold Liuhe with two thousand soldiers, and in the fourth month he marched out to meet Li Jingda's twenty thousand. Liu Renzhan, who held Shouzhou, was Southern Tang's other pillar; he repeatedly threw back the Zhou assaults and held the Huainan line until the following year.
kits: 卡面的秦連弩是中國弩兵的代表裝備：以重複弩機連續供矢、連續發射，屬於軍隊遠程火力的一環，並可與弓兵及城防火力協同；後世稱為諸葛弩的連射弩，名稱雖晚出，弩機與重複供矢的思路在秦漢以來的中國弩兵傳統中已自有源流。六合之戰的史料並沒有寫明哪一方在城頭或渡口實際架設了連弩，但可以確定的是，弩是南唐與後周都配給步卒的制式裝備：壽州城下晝夜攻城，守方倚城弩與弓箭應之；渡江與爭船的場面則顯示南唐主力是水軍與舟師。除了弩，此役可考的裝備還有弓、槊與長兵、刀、鎧甲與盾，攻城一方的巢車、雲梯與投擲火器的攻城器具，渡河用的浮橋，以及唐軍自瓜步渡江所乘的戰艦——趙匡胤在渦口一戰便俘獲五十餘艘，另有一批船隻在南唐敗軍搶渡時被擠滿，慌亂中有人溺死。連弩雖未在記載中點名，它所代表的弩兵體系，正是周軍能以二千兵封住城頭、以強弩壓住列陣唐兵的底氣。
kitsEn: The Qin repeating crossbow on the card face is the standard piece of the Chinese crossbow arm: a repeating trigger mechanism that feeds bolts continuously and shoots in succession, one element of the army's long-range firepower, working together with the archers and the firepower of the defences. The repeating crossbow later called the Zhuge repeating crossbow got its name late, but the idea of the trigger and of the repeated feeding of bolts has its own lineage in the Chinese crossbow tradition from the Qin and Han periods onward. The records of the Battle of Liuhe do not state which side actually set up repeating crossbows on the walls or at the crossing, but what is certain is that the crossbow was a standard issue weapon of the infantry on both the Tang and the Zhou side. At Shouzhou the city was assaulted day and night and the defenders answered with crossbows and arrows from the walls; the scenes of crossing the river and of fighting for the boats show that the main strength of Southern Tang lay in its river force and its war craft. Besides the crossbow, the equipment attested in this campaign includes the bow, the spear and other long weapons, the sword, armour and shields, the siege ladders, scaling frames and projectile engines of the attackers, the floating bridges used to cross the water, and the war vessels in which the Tang troops crossed the Yangtze from Guabu. A single action at Guokou brought Zhao Kuangyin more than fifty of those vessels, and another batch of boats was packed with soldiers trying to cross the river after the defeat, with many drowned in the confusion. The repeating crossbow is not named in the sources, but the crossbow arm it stands for is exactly what allowed a Zhou force of two thousand to seal the city and press Tang troops drawn up in formation.
tactics: 後周此役的戰術可以分三段看。第一段是分路出擊與誘伏：趙匡胤、韓令坤各率一軍去切斷南唐援軍，趙匡胤在渦口設伏，先放唐軍進來再合攏殲之，斬何延錫、奪五十餘艘戰艦，切斷唐軍由長江入淮的正面通道。第二段是強攻與奇襲並行：世宗在壽州城下晝夜猛攻，劉仁贍據城死守，周軍改由李重進、李谷續圍，同時轉派精兵夜行——趙匡胤靠當地村民為嚮導，繞山後小路、跨浮西澗直入滁州城內，以巷戰得勝，一日之內攻下州城、擒獲南唐兩名主將。第三段是據城待敵：三月李景達率二萬渡江北進，世宗命趙匡胤以二千兵守六合，趙匡胤不貿然出城，而是先穩守城池、等待敵軍列陣；四月李景達在城外三十里紮營觀望，趙匡胤才出城死戰，迫其潰散，殘部爭船渡江南逃。南唐方面的戰術則暴露問題：皇甫暉在山下布陣，遭側擊後退入滁州、斷橋固守，是成功的守城思路；李景達屯兵三十里不進，讓援軍停在半途而錯失時機；全役後段霖雨積旬，周軍糧運不濟、士卒疲憊，又無水戰之備，才被迫放棄控江，縮回壽州城下專攻一點。
tacticsEn: The Zhou tactics of this campaign can be read in three stages. The first was the thrust along separate columns combined with the ambush: Zhao Kuangyin and Han Lingkun each led a column to cut off the Tang relief armies, and at Guokou Zhao Kuangyin laid an ambush, letting the Tang advance in before closing on them, killing He Yanxi and taking more than fifty war vessels, thereby cutting the direct channel by which Tang troops came from the Yangtze into the Huai. The second stage combined pressure with surprise: Shizong hammered the walls of Shouzhou day and night, Liu Renzhan held the city, and the Zhou siege was handed to Li Zhongjin and Li Gu while picked troops were sent out to move by night. Guided by local villagers, Zhao Kuangyin took the path behind the mountain, crossed the Feixi Stream and entered Chuzhou itself, winning a street battle and taking the city with two Tang commanders captured in a single day. The third stage was the defence of the city while waiting for the enemy: in the third month Li Jingda led twenty thousand men north across the river, and the emperor ordered Zhao Kuangyin to hold Liuhe with two thousand soldiers. Zhao Kuangyin did not sally out rashly; he first stabilised the defence and waited for the Tang to deploy. In the fourth month Li Jingda pitched his camp thirty li from the city and stood off, and only then did Zhao Kuangyin fight out, crushing the formation so that the remnants crowded into the boats to cross back to the south bank. The Tang tactics reveal the weakness of their side: Huangfu Hui deployed below the hills and, struck on the flank, fell back into Chuzhou and held it behind cut bridges, a sound defensive idea; Li Jingda halted thirty li from the city and never advanced, leaving the relief army stranded halfway and losing the moment. In the later stage of the campaign heavy rain fell for ten days and more, the Zhou supply line failed, the troops were exhausted, and with no river force they had to give up control of the river and concentrate solely on the city of Shouzhou.
data: 可考的數字集中在兵力與時間兩端。正月二十二日起，世宗下令晝夜攻壽州城，相持數日後改由李重進、李谷主持圍城；正月二十六日，趙匡胤在渦口一戰，斬唐軍都監何延錫，俘獲戰艦五十餘艘，隨後率數千兵趕到清流關，二月初以這支小部隊遇上皇甫暉、姚鳳所部萬餘人而取勝。三月，南唐齊王李景達、監軍使陳覺率兵二萬渡長江，自瓜步上岸北上；世宗以趙匡胤率兵二千守六合。四月，李景達大軍紮營在離城三十里處，趙匡胤出戰後，唐軍陣亡近五千人，餘眾爭船渡江南逃，慌亂中多有人溺死。壽州圍城自正月一直延續到次年正月，其間雙方都曾徵召數十萬丁夫參與攻壽州與運糧。周軍方面，四月之後霖雨積旬，糧運不濟、軍隊疲憊，五月世宗返回京師，下令工匠造戰船、組建水軍；七月，李景達、陳覺又率五萬兵抵達濬州一帶，作為壽州聲援而未即決戰。史文中人數多為概數，諸說並存，確切傷亡各書記載不一，宜從寬看待，不宜當作精確統計。
dataEn: The attested figures cluster on two ends, manpower and time. From the twenty-second day of the first month Shizong ordered day-and-night assaults on the city of Shouzhou, and after several days of stalemate the siege was placed under Li Zhongjin and Li Gu. On the twenty-sixth day Zhao Kuangyin won the action at Guokou, killing the Tang Commissioner He Yanxi and capturing more than fifty war vessels, and then marched with several thousand men to Qingliu Pass, where in the second month he met and defeated the ten thousand men of Huangfu Hui and Yao Feng. In the third month the Prince of Qi Li Jingda and the Inspector Chen Jue took twenty thousand soldiers over the Yangtze, landing at Guabu and pushing north; the emperor entrusted Liuhe to Zhao Kuangyin with two thousand men. In the fourth month Li Jingda's army camped thirty li from the city; after Zhao Kuangyin came out to fight, close to five thousand Tang soldiers were killed, and the survivors crowded into boats to cross to the south bank, many drowning in the confusion. The siege of Shouzhou ran from the first month of the year to the first month of the next, and on both sides hundreds of thousands of labourers were conscripted for the assault on Shouzhou and for the grain. On the Zhou side, after the fourth month rains fell for ten days and more, supply failed and the army was worn down; in the fifth month the emperor went back to the capital and ordered the craftsmen to build war boats and organise a river force. In the seventh month Li Jingda and Chen Jue again arrived with fifty thousand men in the region of Haozhou to support Shouzhou, without engaging in a decisive action. The numbers in the records are mostly round figures, accounts differ, and the exact casualties are variously reported, so they should be treated loosely rather than as precise statistics.
cause: 起戰的根由，是後周要先取淮南、再圖江南。顯德三年正月，周軍在正陽之戰取勝，世宗立刻把兵鋒壓到壽州城下，因為壽州是淮河南岸的咽喉：拿下它，淮南諸州與長江北岸都會失去屏障。南唐中主李璟起初求和被拒，便改以反攻策應：先派北面行營的皇甫暉、姚鳳北上救援滁州、壽州，又在三月命齊王李景達、監軍使陳覺率二萬大軍渡長江，自瓜步上岸，直指六合、滁州一線，企圖在壽州被圍之際切斷周軍的江北側翼，收復江北失地。對後周而言，值此久攻壽州不下、糧運吃緊之際，必須有一支精兵橫在江北門戶上，否則壽州圍城就會腹背受敵；於是世宗把殿前都虞候趙匡胤與他的二千人馬放在六合，犧牲後方城防也要保住這座橋頭堡。戰事正是在這個背景下打成：以少阻多、據城待敵，才有了四月六合城下的那場死戰。
causeEn: The root of the war lay in the Later Zhou's plan to seize Huainan first and Jiangnan afterwards. In the first month of the third year of Xiande the Zhou army won at Zhengyang, and the emperor immediately pressed his spearhead against the walls of Shouzhou, because Shouzhou was the throat of the southern bank of the Huai: once it fell, the prefectures of Huainan and the whole north bank of the Yangtese would lose their shield. Li Jing of Southern Tang first sued for peace and was refused, so he turned to a counter-offensive in support of his garrison: he sent Huangfu Hui and Yao Feng of the Northern Front Operations northward to relieve Chuzhou and Shouzhou, and in the third month ordered the Prince of Qi Li Jingda and the Inspector Chen Jue to take twenty thousand men over the Yangtze, land at Guabu and drive straight at the Liuhe–Chuzhou line, hoping to cut the Zhou flank on the north side of the river while Shouzhou was besieged and to recover the lost territory north of the Yangtze. For the Later Zhou, with the siege dragging on and the grain already short, a body of picked troops had to be thrown across the northern gateway; otherwise the siege of Shouzhou would be taken in the rear. Hence the emperor placed Zhao Kuangyin and his two thousand men at Liuhe, giving up the rear defences if necessary in order to keep this bridgehead. The battle was fought in exactly that setting: a small force holding a city to stop a large one, fighting from the walls and waiting for the enemy to come.
impact: 六合之戰的直接後果，是南唐第一次大規模的江北反攻被打散。李景達的二萬援軍在城外潰散，齊王退回江南，此後數月不敢再輕率渡江北進；壽州之圍得以繼續維持，南唐也失去了在淮上翻盤的窗口。這一戰同時把趙匡胤推到台前：他在滁州、在六合，都是以小部當大軍、夜襲入城、據城待敵的模範，此後歷侍周世宗南征北討，軍功愈重，為日後統軍滅南唐、直至陳橋兵變後開創北宋埋下伏線。對後周整體戰局而言，守住六合也暴露了一個致命短板：周軍長於騎兵與步卒攻城，卻沒有水軍，霖雨一來糧道即斷，五月世宗不得不返京造戰船、另建水軍；而南唐趁這段空檔一度收復江北諸州。直至顯德四年正月壽州城陷、清淮軍節度使劉仁贍病歿於軍中，南唐才真正失去淮上屏障，五代十國的南北格局自此傾斜。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the Battle of Liuhe was that the first large Tang counter-offensive north of the river was shattered. Li Jingda's twenty thousand men broke up outside the city, the prince withdrew south of the Yangtese, and for months the Tang did not dare cross the river again in force. The siege of Shouzhou could be maintained, and Southern Tang lost its window to reverse the situation on the Huai. At the same time the battle put Zhao Kuangyin in the foreground: at Chuzhou and at Liuhe he was the model of a small force facing a large one, storming a city by night and waiting for the enemy from behind walls. He went on to serve the Zhou emperor in campaigns to the north and the south, accumulating the merit that would later carry him through the conquest of Southern Tang and, after the Chenqiao mutiny, the founding of the Northern Song. For the Later Zhou's war as a whole, the defence of Liuhe also exposed a fatal weakness: the Zhou army was strong in cavalry and in siege infantry but had no river force, and once the rains came the supply line broke; in the fifth month the emperor had to return to the capital, build war boats and raise a new river force, and Southern Tang used that gap to recover several prefectures north of the river for a time. Only when Shouzhou fell in the first month of the following year and Liu Renzhan, Military Commissioner of Qinghuai, died of illness in the camp did Southern Tang truly lose its shield on the Huai, and the balance between north and south in the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms tilted decisively.
result: 四月六合城下，後周以二千兵守城、南唐以二萬眾來攻，結果是南唐大敗：趙匡胤先按兵不出，待李景達列陣逼近才出城死戰，唐軍陣亡近五千人，餘部爭相登船渡江南逃，慌亂中溺死者甚眾，唐兵大損，齊王李景達退回南唐，此後再無力北向。六合城守住，滁州、瓜步一線的江北門戶仍歸後周掌握，壽州之圍得以延續，世宗得以專心經營淮南。戰果很快被放大：同年七月李景達、陳覺雖率五萬兵再抵濬州作聲援，卻採取持重不戰的姿態而錯失戰機；次年正月壽州陷落，南唐失去淮南，江北之地盡歸後周。五代十國末年最後一場大規模的中原與江南較量，就此定下勝負手：後周拿到了南征的跳板，三年後趙匡胤建立的北宋得以順勢取江南，六合城下的那面旗，成了開國的先聲。
resultEn: At Liuhe in the fourth month the Later Zhou held the city with two thousand men while Southern Tang came with twenty thousand, and the result was a severe Tang defeat. Zhao Kuangyin kept his troops in hand, waited until Li Jingda's formation came close, and only then fought out; close to five thousand Tang soldiers were killed, the rest scrambled aboard the boats to cross back to the south bank, many drowned in the panic, the Tang force was shattered and the Prince of Qi withdrew to Southern Tang, never again able to push north. Liuhe held, the northern gateway of Chuzhou and Guabu remained in Zhou hands, the siege of Shouzhou continued, and the emperor was free to concentrate on Huainan. The result was quickly magnified: in the seventh month of the same year Li Jingda and Chen Jue came again with fifty thousand men to support Shouzhou, but took a cautious, non-engaging posture and lost their chance; in the first month of the following year Shouzhou fell, Southern Tang lost Huainan, and the country north of the river passed to the Later Zhou. The last large contest between the Central Plains and Jiangnan in the late Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms thus settled its winner: the Later Zhou gained the springboard for its southern campaign, and three years later the Northern Song founded by Zhao Kuangyin was able to take Jiangnan in turn. The banner flown over Liuhe became the first sign of the coming dynasty.
